description: Stable Floor 2 equipment art-key manifest. Lists the 70 immutable base art keys (50 weapons across 10 families + 20 armor/accessory items) with type, family, slot, and label metadata. Keys are frozen — additions append IDs; existing IDs are never recycled or renamed. Runtime lookup key: equipment/<type>/<base-name> (first dot replaced by slash). Source of truth for placeholder generation and batch art-request waves.

weaponFamilies.label: Heavy Blade
weaponFamilies.description: Slashing or cleaving one- and two-handed blade weapons with high swing weight.

weaponFamilies.label: Blunt
weaponFamilies.description: Bludgeoning weapons that stun and crush rather than cut.

weaponFamilies.label: Polearm
weaponFamilies.description: Reach weapons mounted on long hafts — spears, staves, flails, and saws.

weaponFamilies.label: Bow
weaponFamilies.description: Ranged weapons that project physical ammunition — bows, crossbows, rifles, and guns.

weaponFamilies.label: Thrown
weaponFamilies.description: Weapons designed to be hurled or spun at range — knives, chakrams, bolas, fans.

weaponFamilies.label: Light Blade
weaponFamilies.description: Fast, light cutting and stabbing weapons favoring speed over raw power.

weaponFamilies.label: Wand
weaponFamilies.description: Magically attuned implements that channel elemental or runic forces.

weaponFamilies.label: Alchemical
weaponFamilies.description: Weapons that deploy volatile chemical compounds — sprayers, censers, flasks, kegs.

weaponFamilies.label: Utility
weaponFamilies.description: Improvised or dual-purpose tools repurposed as weapons — whips, shields, picks, shovels.

weaponFamilies.label: Mechanical
weaponFamilies.description: Engineered or clockwork weapons powered by springs, gears, or compressed gas.
